sentences.en: I would like to purchase your latest mail order catalogue.
sentences.zh: 我想购买你们最新的目录。

sentences.en: Would you lend me the latest issue of the magazine?
sentences.zh: 你能把最新一期的杂志借给我吗？

sentences.en: Our latest results are the fruit of his furious efforts.
sentences.zh: 我们最新的结果是他努力工作的成果。

senses.zh: 最新的，最近的；最迟的，最后的
